newsitem.title: GERMANY: Metro seeks to raise approved capital.
newsitem.headline: Metro seeks to raise approved capital.

text.p: German retail group Metro AG said on Tuesday it wanted to seek approval from its shareholders to raise its approved equity capital by up to 250 million marks nominal.
An invitation to the company's July 9 annual shareholders meeting said the right to raise capital should be valid until 2002 and that shareholders would be entitled to subscribe.
Metro said it was also seeking approval to issue up to two billion marks worth of either bonds with warrants or convertible bonds with a maturity of at least 15 years.
In order to back the option rights on the bonds, Metro asked the AGM to approve the creation of a further 100 million marks in capital.
